method: DEM silo discharge through a square orifice at four sizes, with a Beverloo fit
code: Project Chrono / PyChrono core ChSystemSMC (Hertz, MultiStep tangential), Bullet collision, CPU, 1 thread
notes: Coarse-grained 4x (mean d 1.70 mm), E=2e5 Pa, 16 mm silo, 0.2 s settle + 0.6 s discharge per orifice. Bullet with SI (metre) units blew up (grains ejected at about 700 m/s within 0.02 s, as PR #180 also saw), so Chrono runs internally in millimetres. SetRollingFriction has no effect in core ChSystemSMC (identical rolling-sphere speed with mu_roll 0 and 0.3). The L=5.5 mm (L/d=3.2) flow was slow and intermittent, near jamming.
